content: Mighty Networks: activity-feed social model; events native in Spaces; 3-state RSVP (Going/Maybe/Not Going), per-occurrence RSVP for recurring; auto reminders 10 min before online, 24h (+2h per one source) before in-person; add-to-calendar + Google/Outlook/Apple sync; see who RSVP'd; host can close RSVPs, message attendees by segment, export CSV; no check-in feature documented. Pinning = Featured Sections (global or per space) + Recommend (bumps to top). Branded standalone app only on Mighty Pro; standard plans share the Mighty app.
